title: Machine learning method based on federal learning
assignee: Hangzhou Yikang Huilian Technology Co ltd

pse.problem: Inefficiency in converging machine learning models based on federal learning due to poor interaction between training nodes during data collaboration
pse.solution_function: A federated learning method performs character processing and model training on local training data using a Poisson regression algorithm. It exchanges gradient information and updates model weights among training nodes, encrypts intermediate data, and collaboratively calculates updated results.
pse.solution_structure: The system consists of training nodes (initiating node and participating node) and a forwarding node. Each node has the capability to perform character processing, model training, gradient calculation, encryption, and decryption.
pse.solution_implementation: Training nodes process local data, send gradient information to the forwarding node, receive gradient information from other nodes, update local model weights, encrypt intermediate data, and collaboratively calculate updated results. The forwarding node distributes encrypted intermediate data to each training node.
pse.effect: Improved convergence of machine learning models due to efficient interaction between training nodes in a networked data collaboration mode
